ABRUPT_INCREASE_OF_BSW.label: Abrupt increase of BSW
ABRUPT_INCREASE_OF_BSW.description: Sudden rise in the fraction of water and sediment in the produced liquid.

SPURIOUS_CLOSURE_OF_DHSV.label: Spurious closure of DHSV
SPURIOUS_CLOSURE_OF_DHSV.description: The downhole safety valve closes by itself, usually without any surface indication; production stops.

SEVERE_SLUGGING.label: Severe slugging
SEVERE_SLUGGING.description: Periodic, intense flow instability detectable along the whole production circuit; can stress or damage equipment.

FLOW_INSTABILITY.label: Flow instability
FLOW_INSTABILITY.description: Non-periodic, tolerable flow disturbances that can evolve into severe slugging.

RAPID_PRODUCTIVITY_LOSS.label: Rapid productivity loss
RAPID_PRODUCTIVITY_LOSS.description: System energy no longer overcomes losses; flow declines and natural flow can be lost.

QUICK_RESTRICTION_IN_PCK.label: Quick restriction in PCK
QUICK_RESTRICTION_IN_PCK.description: Fast, unwanted restriction of the production choke caused by operational problems.

SCALING_IN_PCK.label: Scaling in PCK
SCALING_IN_PCK.description: Inorganic deposits build up in the production choke and gradually restrict flow.

HYDRATE_IN_PRODUCTION_LINE.label: Hydrate in production line
HYDRATE_IN_PRODUCTION_LINE.description: Ice-like water–gas crystals form at high pressure and low temperature and can block the production line.

HYDRATE_IN_SERVICE_LINE.label: Hydrate in service line
HYDRATE_IN_SERVICE_LINE.description: Hydrate blockage in the service (gas-lift) line.

equipment.label: Reservoir
equipment.description: Rock formation that supplies oil, gas and water

equipment.label: Permanent downhole gauge
equipment.description: Pressure/temperature gauge deep in the well, below the DHSV

equipment.label: Downhole safety valve
equipment.description: Fail-safe valve in the production tubing, held open hydraulically

equipment.label: Production tubing
equipment.description: Pipe that carries fluid from the reservoir to the seabed

equipment.label: Subsea Christmas tree (TPT)
equipment.description: Valve assembly on the seabed; carries the TPT pressure/temperature transducer

equipment.label: Production line (flowline + riser)
equipment.description: Pipe from the subsea tree up to the platform

equipment.label: Production choke (PCK)
equipment.description: Topside valve that controls the well's flow

equipment.label: Platform process plant
equipment.description: Separators and processing downstream of the choke

equipment.label: Service line
equipment.description: Line from the platform to the well used for gas lift and operations

equipment.label: Well annulus
equipment.description: Space between tubing and casing; gas-lift gas travels down here

causes.text: Water breakthrough (aquifer or injected water reaches the well)
DHSV or its hydraulic actuator fails and closes the valve with no surface command
Liquid accumulates at the riser base, then is pushed out by gas in cycles
Gas–liquid flow disturbances without a regular cycle
Reservoir properties change (pressure, BSW, GOR, viscosity) so energy no longer overcomes losses
Operational problem closes the production choke unintentionally
Inorganic deposits (scale) form in the choke
Water and gas at high pressure and low temperature form hydrate crystals in the production line
Water and gas at high pressure and low temperature form hydrate crystals in the service line

stakeholders.concern: Fast, clear alarms; few false alarms; simple steps
Accurate diagnosis; keep the well producing
Minimise intervention cost (rigs can exceed US$500k/day)
Understand water breakthrough and productivity changes
